name: Fashion
title: Zuri Atelier: how a fashion business runs on Taskiem
blurb: One week at Zuri Atelier, a made-to-measure tailor in Surulere, Lagos: from the first day to a full week of orders, fittings, money, staff and suppliers, all run alongside the chats Zainab already has with her customers. Episode 0 shows the whole week; Episodes 1 to 10 teach each part.
card_sub: A week at Zuri Atelier: orders, fittings, money, staff and suppliers.
cta_sub: Taskiem works alongside your chats: orders, stock, money and staff, taken care of.
